s1.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal pain with intermittent throbbing and localization to the right lower quadrant, associated with nausea and increased stool frequency, and a complex medical history
salient_findings: Intermittent throbbing abdominal pain localizing to the right lower quadrant
Moderate tenderness in the right lower quadrant and positive Rovsing sign
Lobulated tubular soft tissue and inflammation adjacent to the terminal ileum/ileocecal valve on CT
No appendix identified on CT or laparoscopy
Biopsy showing acute inflammation and foci of endometriosis
Small-bowel obstruction at the terminal ileum on repeat CT
key_facts: Pain began periumbilically and localized to the right lower quadrant
Associated with nausea and increased stool frequency
History of supracervical hysterectomy with bilateral salpingectomy for uterine fibroids in 2012
Moderate tenderness in the right lower quadrant on examination
Contrast-enhanced CT showed lobulated tubular soft tissue and inflammation adjacent to the terminal ileum/ileocecal valve
Appendix not identified on CT or laparoscopy
Biopsy of inflamed areas showed acute inflammation and foci of endometriosis
Repeat CT showed small-bowel obstruction at the terminal ileum

shortlist.label: Endometriosis
shortlist.why_kept: Noted during 2012 surgery and biopsy of inflamed areas showed foci of endometriosis

shortlist.label: Acute appendicitis
shortlist.why_kept: Initial presumptive diagnosis based on CT findings and symptoms

shortlist.label: Small-bowel obstruction
shortlist.why_kept: Repeat CT showed small-bowel obstruction at the terminal ileum

shortlist.label: Intestinal endometriosis
shortlist.why_kept: Biopsy of inflamed areas showed foci of endometriosis and patient has history of endometriosis

shortlist.label: Crohn's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Terminal ileitis and small-bowel obstruction are possible manifestations of Crohn's disease

shortlist.label: Terminal ileitis
shortlist.why_kept: Contrast-enhanced CT showed inflammation adjacent to the terminal ileum/ileocecal valve

shortlist.label: Pericecal abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Repeat CT showed small-bowel obstruction at the terminal ileum, likely secondary to an adjacent pericecal soft-tissue mass

shortlist.label: Meckel's diverticulitis
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of acute abdominal pain and inflammation in the right lower quadrant

raw.rationale: The patient's history of endometriosis, biopsy showing foci of endometriosis in inflamed areas, and the presence of a pericecal soft-tissue mass causing small-bowel obstruction are consistent with intestinal endometriosis.

rejected.label: Acute appendicitis
rejected.why: Appendix not identified on CT or laparoscopy

rejected.label: Small-bowel obstruction
rejected.why: Too broad, as it is a complication rather than a primary diagnosis

rejected.label: Endometriosis
rejected.why: Too general, as intestinal endometriosis is a more specific diagnosis that explains the patient's symptoms

rejected.label: Crohn's disease
rejected.why: No clear evidence of chronic inflammation or other typical Crohn's disease features

rejected.label: Terminal ileitis
rejected.why: Could be a feature of Crohn's disease or other conditions, but not specifically supported by the biopsy results

rejected.label: Pericecal abscess
rejected.why: Not directly supported by the imaging or biopsy results, which suggest a soft-tissue mass rather than an abscess

rejected.label: Meckel's diverticulitis
rejected.why: No evidence of a Meckel's diverticulum on imaging or laparoscopy
